idea-plugin.name: Idempotency Key Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter warning icon on any Java/Kotlin Spring MVC @PostMapping/@PutMapping (or @RequestMapping(method = ...)) endpoint method with no @RequestHeader parameter for an idempotency key -- the classic footgun where a retried or double-submitted POST/PUT creates a duplicate side effect (a duplicate order, a duplicate charge) because nothing in the handler recognizes "I already saw this exact request".

100% static PSI analysis -- matches Spring annotations by simple name only, so it works whether the real Spring jar is on the classpath or not. Java and Kotlin.

Stated honestly: covers Spring MVC only (not JAX-RS or other frameworks), and the idempotency-key parameter is recognized by its header name containing "idempotency" or "idempotence" (case-insensitive, both real spellings teams actually use) -- a team using a differently-named header convention entirely (e.g. Client-Request-Token) isn't covered yet. Real, documented limitations, not bugs.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
